hero.title: Create and refine images
hero.subtitle: Generate from a description, edit a photo, or change the camera angle — all in one place.

empty.canvasHint: Describe the scene on the left
empty.canvasDescription: Enter a description, optionally set the size, then press Create — the result appears on the canvas.
empty.editReadyHint: Describe the changes on the left
empty.editReadyDescription: Press Apply — the updated frame appears next to the original.
empty.editMissingDescription: Choose an image on the left, describe the edits, then press Apply.
empty.rotateHint: Choose an image and a camera mode first
empty.rotateDescription: After Change angle, the result appears here; All angles shows a grid of frames.
empty.historyDescription: After generation or editing, items appear here so you can preview and download them.
